description: The plot illustrates the comparison of different query selection strategies, showing the Mean Reciprocal Rank at 10 (MRR@10) against the number of queries used during inference. The x-axis is labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)" with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 10, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "MRR@10" with a linear scale, ranging from 33.0 to 36.5, and tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The plot contains 14 lines, representing different query selection strategies, with solid lines indicating well-trained DPR retrievers with corpus expansion and dotted lines representing the typical representation on the dev set of MS-Marco. The lines are colored in black, red, blue, purple, and green, with various marker shapes and line styles. The "DPR w/o query" line (black solid) starts at 33.4 and remains steady. The "DPR w/ gold" (red solid) and "DPR w/ top-1" (blue solid) lines start at around 34.8 and 34.7, and end at 35.7 and 35.9, respectively. The "DPR w/ average" (blue dotted) starts at 35.1 and ends at 35.7. The "DPR w/ curriculum" (green solid and dotted) starts at 33.0 and 34.5, and ends at 35.6 and 35.7, respectively. Other lines show similar trends, with some starting at different initial values and increasing or remaining steady across the x-axis.
